hero.title: Solutions for Every Market
hero.lead: Tissue, hygiene and customised product solutions for households, retailers, hospitality, corporate organisations, events, private-label brands and export buyers.

groups.title: Household
groups.summary: Unisoft, Aimishu and selected everyday tissue formats.
groups.body: Everyday tissue for Malaysian homes — soft, dependable and widely available through retail channels.

groups.title: Retail Chains & Distributors
groups.summary: Cili, Wasabi, Unisoft, Aimishu, retail-ready supply and private-label opportunities.
groups.body: Retail-ready supply across Unikota's own brands, with wholesale, distribution and range-development support.

groups.title: Restaurants, Cafés & HoReCa
groups.summary: Serviettes, napkins, kitchen towels, washroom products and customised branded formats.
groups.body: Front-of-house and back-of-house paper products for food service, with customised branded serviettes for venues that want their identity on the table.

groups.title: Corporate & Institutional
groups.summary: Facial tissue, washroom and pantry products, branded tissue and multi-location delivery.
groups.body: Reliable tissue supply for offices, facilities and institutions — including customised corporate tissue and coordinated delivery across locations.

groups.title: Events & Corporate Gifting
groups.summary: Custom boxes, packs, serviettes, campaign products and limited editions.
groups.body: Customised tissue products designed around campaigns, events and gifting programmes — from concept and packaging design through production and delivery.
items: Licensed-brand projects where rights are approved

groups.title: OEM, Private Label & Export
groups.summary: Customer-owned brands, packaging development, manufacturing, packing and export coordination.
groups.body: End-to-end support for customer-owned brands — from product development and packaging design through manufacturing, packing and export coordination.
